assign.outcome:
**Generator wave 7 — a copy button, a quiet teacher, a shelf for your own trees.** The three roadmap items wave 6 left, all three built. `MODEL` untouched at **3** — `gen.js`/`rules.js` read-only, never edited; sha1 of `gen(seed)` identical before and after on all six proof seeds (`#1 991d25bc543f · #7 1d5901c444dc · #42 a332499027a8 · #99 1d34ff076163 · #1234 dbe5a58ae750 · #90210 aa993d0f6e9f`).

![](saved-band.png)

**1 · Copy the address** — an icon button beside the seed stepper takes `location.origin + this.url + this.hash()`. *Proof:* a Playwright context granted `clipboard-read`/`clipboard-write`, clicked it, and `navigator.clipboard.readText()` read back the exact address; the icon swapped `content_copy` → `check` for a beat and reverted. The string also rides on the instance (`this.copied`) as a fallback for a prover with no grant.

**2 · The spec box names what it doesn't know** — measured first: `read()` (spec.js) is one ternary, an unrecognised word already silently became `prose`, no error, ever. `unknown()` (controls.js) re-parses the box's own text to report that, touching nothing in the draw path; wired to the textarea's `input` event and to `draw()`, so the line survives both live typing and a committed spec. Quiet — `.page-gen-ok`'s italic voice, never the red `.page-gen-bad` — and never an alert: verified by listening for `dialog` events across the whole run and getting zero.

![](spec-hint.png)

**3 · "Yours" — save the tree you're looking at** — a title field and a save button in the gallery read `host.spec` (the live tree) and push `{id,title,spec}` into `store()`. **The store-key call:** the SAME key `sized`/`gapped`/`looked`/`hash` already live in, not a sibling one — a saved spec is exactly as dressing-adjacent as those three, and a second key is a second thing to keep in step with `store_key`'s own warning. That choice found a real bug on the way in: `remember()` was calling `store().set()`, a full replace, so the very next size/gap/look change would have silently erased every saved spec — changed to `store().patch()`. *Proof, a real reload, not a repaint:* saved a spec titled "My proof tree", `page.reload()`, card and dressing both survived; removed it (by id, via a `div` + `stopPropagation`, never a button nested in the card's own `<a>`), reloaded again, gone both times.

![](copy-confirmed.png)

**Verified** — headless against a private `node server.js` on `:8097` (never `:80`, torn down after; a sibling session's own `:8099` server was left untouched): the full save/reload/remove/reload round trip, the clipboard read-back, the spec hint through typing/commit/fix, 400 / 1920 / 3440 on both `/generator/` and `/generator/specs/`. Zero console errors, zero dialogs, across the entire run.

**Cut:** nothing — all three were XS/S/M and fit. Left for later, per wave 6's own list: arriving deeper than one root (fights Back), exporting a tree as real `page.js` files.
